namespaces.name: Namespace: Art Boards
namespaces.purpose: Visualize resources and coordinate agent sessions with human-machine collaboration tools.
namespaces.description: Tools for coordinating agent sessions and discovering and visualizing resources and artefacts.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Art Domains
namespaces.purpose: Curated domains for operational knowledge and workflows.
namespaces.description: Distributable artificial resources within knowledge and work domains: structures, templates, processes, agent instructions, modes, and skills.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Art JS
namespaces.purpose: Tools for working with Art files as programs.
namespaces.description: Art JS libraries and tools for authoring, validating, and projecting Art MD programs.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Art Lib
namespaces.purpose: Build high quality, consistent, Cli and Tool experiences from composable units.
namespaces.description: Shared libraries and tools for building CLIs and Tools.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Art MD
namespaces.purpose: Express structured data in Markdown with an extensible language.
namespaces.description: Art MD language spec, libraries, and tools.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Art Works
namespaces.purpose: Manage multi-repository development environments for parallel planning and execution.
namespaces.description: Tools for discovering projects, managing knowledge and context resources, and operating across multiple checkouts: cloning, visualizing, synchronizing, and executing commands.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Artisans
namespaces.purpose: Hand-crafted micro applications for humans working with Art and Artificials.
namespaces.description: No-build vanilla HTML/CSS/JS apps. State lives in plain JSON files next to each app. Each app is served with a single zero-dependency node http script.

namespaces.name: Namespace: No Comply
namespaces.purpose: Publish the No Comply SolidJS packages under a shared identity.
namespaces.description: SolidJS libraries for accessibility, composables, contexts, dev tooling, and primitives, with the meta extraction CLI and standard UI demo.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Noodle Commons
namespaces.purpose: Publish the Commons tooling packages under a shared identity.
namespaces.description: Packages published from `noodlestan/commons`: the Indexer (`@noodle-commons/indexer`) and Peer (`@noodle-commons/peer`) CLIs.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Noodlestan
namespaces.purpose: Publish the shared Noodlestan ecosystem conventions, tools, and components under one canonical npm scope.
namespaces.description: Packages published from multiple Noodlestan repositories `noodlestan/conventions`, `noodlestan/noodlestan-web`, and `noodlestan/workspace-tooling`.

namespaces.name: Namespace: Purrception
namespaces.purpose: Publish the Purrception language tooling packages under a shared identity.
namespaces.description: TypeScript language extraction libraries and source tooling (`lang-ts`, `lang-ts-extract`, `source-fs`, `primitives`).

namespaces.name: Namespace: Purrpose
namespaces.purpose: Publish the Purrpose client packages under a shared identity.
namespaces.description: Client-side Babel tooling and SolidJS service packages (`client-babel`, its presets, and `solid-shiki-service`).

namespaces.name: Namespace: Purrtrait
namespaces.purpose: Publish the Purrtrait rendering packages under a shared identity.
